query:
SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.description,
  e.amount,
  e.competenceMonth,
  ma.name as contaGerencial,
  am.accountingCode,
  ca.code as codigoContabil,
  ca.name as contaContabil,
  CASE 
    WHEN ca.code LIKE '5%' THEN 'CUSTO'
    WHEN ca.code LIKE '6%' THEN 'DESPESA'
    ELSE 'OUTRO'
  END as tipo
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN managementAccounts ma ON e.managementAccountId = ma.id
LEFT JOIN accountingMappings am ON ma.id = am.managementAccountId
LEFT JOIN chartOfAccounts ca ON am.accountingCode = ca.code
WHERE e.status = 'ATIVA'
  AND e.competenceMonth = '2026-01'
ORDER BY ca.code, e.amount DESC
